Controller: @nestjs/common: the class decorator marking a handler class
Ctx: @nestjs/microservices: parameter decorator for the transport context
EventPattern: @nestjs/microservices: method decorator subscribing to an event channel
MessagePattern: @nestjs/microservices: method decorator answering a request channel
Payload: @nestjs/microservices: parameter decorator for the message payload
event: suss: label for an @EventPattern handler in a report
message: suss: label for an @MessagePattern handler in a report
nats: transport name, the NATS broker, this pack's default wire
